description: Granting additional provisions to the Paddy Marketing Board to purchase paddy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs. 6,000 million, allocated under the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to implement the paddy purchasing programme for the Yala Season 2026, has been released to the Paddy Marketing Board and the Board is currently engaged in purchasing paddy using the said funds. Nevertheless, as the harvesting of paddy has not yet been completed in the Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Puttalam, Mannar, and Mullaitivu Districts, as well as in the Mahaweli B, C, and H Zones, it has been observed that the currently allocated funds are inadequate for purchasing paddy in those areas. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to release an additional Rs.2,500 million out of the Rs.7,500 million in additional funds allocated to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, to the Paddy Marketing Board on a reimbursement basis, in order to implement the accelerated paddy purchasing programme for purchase of paddy for the Yala Season 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.
